content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(KOI-003 PyPI Package Import Time Subprocess Spawn Post Install Hook) OR BIOC(KOI-003 Cortex Cloud SCA SBOM Digest Matches Known Bad Fingerprint) OR XQL(KOI-003 Outbound HTTPS To Non Canonical PyPI Mirror With Pip User Agent) — stitched by shared agent_hostname + causality_id so the runtime import-time child-spawn, the SCA/SBOM fingerprint finding, and the NGFW mirror fetch (endpoint_network_stitch) collapse into ONE agentic-supply-chain incident
rules.name: Agentic Supply Chain — Backdoored PyPI Package Post-Install Hook
